cohort: The study included 25 patients with ectopic pregnancy and 11 patients with uterine leiomyoma undergoing surgical treatment for gynecological diseases.
finding: Single-port laparoscopy (SPL) demonstrated clinical efficacy with minimal invasion, rapid recovery, and cost-effectiveness for patients with ectopic pregnancy and uterine leiomyoma, despite a significantly longer operation time for ectopic pregnancy cases compared to conventional laparoscopy.
